owner_request: The Owner requested that the expanded 15-minute candidate pool recover the previous small dynamic input, small signal box, variable box position and safe easy/hard-negative method, then train on the RTX 3060 after P0/P1. The candidate and boundary-review experiments deliberately produced no labels. This preregistration freezes the planning-only P1 release gate that must sit between a complete Owner review and any OHLCV read, dataset materialization, negative selection or training.
question: Can an exact complete Owner boundary-review export and an explicit hash-bound SHORT release be converted into a deterministic chronological split and protection-ledger plan while reading no OHLCV and keeping every training/production eligibility flag false?
single_variable: Release-planning gate only: add a fail-closed transformation from an explicitly released SHORT KEEP preview to timestamp-derived dependency blocks, train/val/drop assignments and positive protection intervals; candidate membership, Owner answers, pixels, rendering, labels, negatives, model configuration and eligibility remain unchanged.

owner_release_receipt.creation_rule: Create only after the Owner explicitly releases the exact complete SHORT KEEP preview in conversation. A general request to train, a valid review export or a protocol-level SHORT confirmation is not a release receipt.

planning_contract.timestamp_derivation: Input and core timestamps are derived only from anchor_time plus the Owner-selected W/core/confirmation integers. No OHLCV file is opened.
planning_contract.long_keep_handling: mirror_unconfirmed and excluded from positive and negative roles; its confirmed core interval is retained only as a later negative-protection requirement.
planning_contract.dependency_rule: Same-symbol input windows that overlap or touch form one inseparable dependency block.
planning_contract.validation_assignment: The chronologically latest 15 percent of dependency blocks are validation, rounding to at least one block.
planning_contract.purge_rule: A train block must end at least 150 completed 15-minute bars before the earliest validation input start; intervening blocks are drop.
planning_contract.positive_guard_rule: Expand every Owner-confirmed KEEP core by 12 bars on both sides. This new-batch ledger is necessary but not sufficient: a later negative builder must union it with every historical Owner-box guard before sampling.
negative_matching_requirements: same assigned split and bounded time block
outside the union of all historical and new Owner-box guards
no validation label or score for train selection

fail_closed_conditions: release receipt not bound to the exact summary and SHORT preview hashes
any source or derived timestamp at or after holdout start
any dependency block crossing train and validation
any true training, negative or production eligibility flag
any attempt to overwrite an existing output
